body:
Several updates:
- Improved convergence of saturation adjustment with more accurate derivatives in Newton solver
- GPU performance improvements by reducing exp/log function calls (hoisting them out of SA loop)
- Expanded test coverage
- Corrected several inconsistencies in docs

Bumps minor release (SA convergence changes may affect ClimaAtmos behavior slightly).
title: Thermo updates: SA convergence improvements, expanded tests, docs cleanup
